info.title: API.SH: Grubhub
info.description: The Grubhub API from API.SH: public Grubhub data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

get.summary: Grubhub search suggestions near a point
get.description:
Suggestions Grubhub shows while typing, near an address or point: restaurants (id, name, link, open, distance, delivery time, image), dishes and cuisines.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grubhub-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What has been typed so far.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Address to search near (required unless lat and lon are given).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Grubhub menu item with its options
get.description:
One menu item of a Grubhub restaurant: name, description, prices, images, category, and every option group (name, minimum and maximum choices) with each option's name, price and nested options.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grubhub-item

parameters.name: restaurant_id
parameters.description: Restaurant id (or a grubhub.com restaurant link).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Grandma Pizza
example.description: Homemade marinara sauce, Mozzarella, Extra virgin olive oil and fresh basil.

get.summary: Grubhub restaurant with its full menu
get.description:
One Grubhub restaurant: name, brand, cuisines, logo and image, address, coordinates, phone, rating, rating count and ratings by topic (food, delivery speed, order accuracy), review count, price rating, open status for delivery and pickup, delivery fee, order minimum, sales tax, delivery and pickup times, delivery and pickup hours, accepted payments, tags, offers, and every menu category with every item (id, name, description, price for delivery and pickup, price range, availability, popular flag, image). Use the item id with /grubhub/v1/item for its options.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grubhub-restaurant

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Restaurant id, or a grubhub.com / seamless.com restaurant link.

parameters.name: include_unavailable
parameters.description: true: also list items that are unavailable right now.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

items.name: Margherita Pizza Slice
items.description: Fresh mozzarella, Homemade marinara sauce, Extra virgin olive oil and fresh basil

items.name: Grandma Pizza Slice
items.description: Homemade marinara sauce, Mozzarella, Extra virgin olive oil and fresh basil.

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Grubhub restaurant: author, stars, text, review and order dates, the reviewer's review count, the items ordered, the restaurant's replies, and the total count. Sorts: newest, rating_high, rating_low. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grubhub-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Restaurant id, or a grubhub.com restaurant link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

reviews.author: Ronnie
reviews.text: Pizza was delicious. On time and still hot!

reviews.author: rondi
reviews.text: The Grandma Pizza is the best I have ever tasted!

get.summary: Grubhub restaurants delivering to an address
get.description:
Restaurants Grubhub lists for an address or a point (the same restaurants Seamless shows), optionally for a dish, cuisine or restaurant name: id, name, link, cuisines, rating and count, price rating, distance, delivery and pickup flags, open now, delivery time and range, pickup time, delivery fee, delivery minimum, service fee, next open / close, address and coordinates, phone, logo and image, offers, badges, new and chain flags, and the dishes each restaurant matched (name, description, price, category, image). Filters: open now, cuisine, minimum rating, price, maximum delivery time, offers, new; sorts: default, distance, rating, price, delivery time; delivery or pickup. `limit` sets the page size; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grubhub-search

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Delivery address (or pass lat and lon).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the results (default: the site's order).

parameters.name: cuisine
parameters.description: A cuisine, e.g. italian, chinese, sushi.

parameters.name: max_delivery_minutes
parameters.description: Only restaurants delivering within this many minutes.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

matched_items.name: Pizza Bianca Pizza
matched_items.description: Classic white pizza, mozzarella, ricotta and Romano.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
